verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֥ן בְּכֽוֹר־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ כִּ֣י ה֣וּא הַבְּכוֹר֒ וּֽבְחַלְּלוֹ֙ יְצוּעֵ֣י אָבִ֔יו נִתְּנָה֙ בְּכֹ֣רָת֔וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א לְהִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ לַבְּכֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên bə·ḵō·wr- yiś·rā·’êl kî hū hab·bə·ḵō·wr ū·ḇə·ḥal·lə·lōw yə·ṣū·‘ê ’ā·ḇîw nit·tə·nāh bə·ḵō·rā·ṯōw liḇ·nê yō·w·sêp̄ ben- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō lə·hiṯ·ya·ḥêś lab·bə·ḵō·rāh
verses.literal: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel . . . Though he was the firstborn his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel because Reuben defiled his father’s bed So he is not reckoned according to birthright
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel ( Ele era o primogênito, mas, porquanto violou o leito de seu pai, foi o seu direito da primogenitura dado aos filhos de José, filho de Israel; e a genealogia não se deve contar segundo o direito da primogenitura.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ גָּבַ֣ר בְּאֶחָ֔יו וּלְנָגִ֖יד מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהַבְּכֹרָ֖ה לְיוֹסֵֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî yə·hū·ḏāh gā·ḇar bə·’e·ḥāw ū·lə·nā·ḡîḏ mim·men·nū wə·hab·bə·ḵō·rāh lə·yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him the birthright belonged to Joseph
verses.literalPt: Pois Judá prevaleceu sobre seus irmãos, e dele veio o príncipe; mas o direito da primogenitura foi de José).

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲנ֥וֹךְ וּפַלּ֖וּא חֶצְר֥וֹן וְכַרְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên bə·ḵō·wr yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·nō·wḵ ū·p̄al·lū ḥeṣ·rō·wn wə·ḵar·mî
verses.literal: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel Hanoch Pallu Hezron and Carmi
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel: Enoque, Palu, Hezrom e Carmi.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יוֹאֵ֑ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ גּ֥וֹג בְּנ֖וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yō·w·’êl šə·ma‘·yāh ḇə·nōw gō·wḡ bə·nōw šim·‘î ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: The descendants of Joel Shemaiah his son Gog his son Shimei his son
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Joel, de quem foi filho Semaías, de quem foi filho Gogue, de quem foi filho Simei;

verses.original: מִיכָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ רְאָיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ בַּ֥עַל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî·ḵāh ḇə·nōw rə·’ā·yāh ḇə·nōw ba·‘al bə·nōw
verses.literal: Micah his son Reaiah his son Baal his son
verses.literalPt: de quem foi filho Mica, de quem foi filho Reaías, de quem foi filho Baal;

verses.original: בְּאֵרָ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשֻּׁ֑ר ה֥וּא נָשִׂ֖יא לָרֽאוּבֵנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ê·rāh ḇə·nōw ’ă·šer heḡ·lāh til·lə·ḡaṯ pil·nə·’e·ser me·leḵ ’aš·šur hū nā·śî lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: and Beerah his son whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites
verses.literalPt: de quem foi filho Beera, a quem levou cativo Tiglate-Pileser, rei da Assíria. Ele foi príncipe dos rubenitas.

verses.original: וְאֶחָיו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔יו בְּהִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֑ם הָרֹ֥אשׁ יְעִיאֵ֖ל וּזְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’e·ḥāw lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯāw bə·hiṯ·ya·ḥêś lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām hā·rōš yə·‘î·’êl ū·zə·ḵar·yā·hū
verses.literal: His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy Jeiel the chief Zechariah
verses.literalPt: Seus irmãos, pelas suas famílias, quando se fez a genealogia das suas gerações: o príncipe Jeiel, Zacarias

verses.original: וּבֶ֙לַע֙ בֶּן־ עָזָ֔ז בֶּן־ שֶׁ֖מַע בֶּן־ יוֹאֵ֑ל ה֚וּא יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּעֲרֹעֵ֔ר וְעַד־ נְב֖וֹ וּבַ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇe·la‘ ben- ‘ā·zāz ben- še·ma‘ ben- yō·w·’êl hū yō·wō·šêḇ ba·‘ă·rō·‘êr wə·‘aḏ- nə·ḇōw ū·ḇa·‘al mə·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: and Bela son of Azaz the son of Shema the son of Joel They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon
verses.literalPt: e Bela, filho de Azaz, filho de Sema, filho de Joel, os quais moravam em Aroer, até Nebo e Baal-Meom;

verses.original: וְלַמִּזְרָ֗ח יָשַׁב֙ עַד־ לְב֣וֹא מִדְבָּ֔רָה לְמִן־ הַנָּהָ֖ר פְּרָ֑ת כִּ֧י מִקְנֵיהֶ֛ם רָב֖וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lam·miz·rāḥ yā·šaḇ ‘aḏ- lə·ḇō·w miḏ·bā·rāh lə·min- han·nā·hār pə·rāṯ kî miq·nê·hem rā·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: They also settled in the east as far as . . . the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead
verses.literalPt: e, para o oriente, habitou até a entrada do deserto desde o rio Eufrates, porque os seus gados se tinham multiplicado na terra de Gileade.

verses.original: וּבִימֵ֣י שָׁא֗וּל עָשׂ֤וּ מִלְחָמָה֙ עִם־ הַֽהַגְרִאִ֔ים וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאָ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם עַֽל־ כָּל־ פְּנֵ֖י מִזְרָ֥ח לַגִּלְעָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇî·mê šā·’ūl ‘ā·śū mil·ḥā·māh ‘im- ha·haḡ·ri·’îm way·yip·pə·lū bə·yā·ḏām way·yê·šə·ḇū bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem ‘al- kāl- pə·nê miz·rāḥ lag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites who were defeated at their hands and they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout . . . the region east of Gilead
verses.literalPt: Nos dias de Saul, pelejaram contra os hagarenos, que caíram pela sua mão, e habitaram nas suas tendas em toda a terra da banda oriental de Gileade.

verses.original: וּבְנֵי־ גָ֣ד לְנֶגְדָּ֗ם יָֽשְׁב֛וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־ סַלְכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ lə·neḡ·dām yā·šə·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ hab·bā·šān ‘aḏ- sal·ḵāh
verses.literal: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah
verses.literalPt: Defronte deles, habitaram os filhos de Gade na terra de Basã até Salca:

verses.original: יוֹאֵ֣ל הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְשָׁפָ֖ם הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְיַעְנַ֥י וְשָׁפָ֖ט בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’êl hā·rōš wə·šā·p̄ām ham·miš·neh wə·ya‘·nay wə·šā·p̄āṭ bab·bā·šān
verses.literal: Joel was the chief Shapham the second then Jaanai and Shaphat who lived in Bashan
verses.literalPt: o príncipe Joel, e o segundo, Safã, e Janai e Safate, em Basã;

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֞ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וּמְשֻׁלָּ֡ם וְ֠שֶׁבַע וְיוֹרַ֧י וְיַעְכָּ֛ן וְזִ֥יעַ וָעֵ֖בֶר שִׁבְעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥê·hem lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem mî·ḵā·’êl ū·mə·šul·lām wə·še·ḇa‘ wə·yō·w·ray wə·ya‘·kān wə·zî·a‘ wā·‘ê·ḇer šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: Their kinsmen by families were . . . Michael Meshullam Sheba Jorai Jacan Zia and Eber seven in all
verses.literalPt: e seus irmãos das casas de seus pais: Micael, Mesulão, Seba, Jorai, Jacã, Zia e Éber, sete.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ בְּנֵ֣י אֲבִיחַ֗יִל בֶּן־ חוּרִ֡י בֶּן־ יָ֠רוֹחַ בֶּן־ גִּלְעָ֧ד בֶּן־ מִיכָאֵ֛ל בֶּן־ יְשִׁישַׁ֥י בֶּן־ יַחְדּ֖וֹ בֶּן־ בּֽוּז׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh bə·nê ’ă·ḇî·ḥa·yil ben- ḥū·rî ben- yā·rō·w·aḥ ben- gil·‘āḏ ben- mî·ḵā·’êl ben- yə·šî·šay ben- yaḥ·dōw ben- būz
verses.literal: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri the son of Jaroah the son of Gilead the son of Michael the son of Jeshishai the son of Jahdo the son of Buz
verses.literalPt: Estes foram os filhos de Abiail, filho de Huri, filho de Jaroa, filho de Gileade, filho de Micael, filho de Jesisai, filho de Jado, filho de Buz;

verses.original: אֲחִי֙ בֶּן־ עַבְדִּיאֵ֣ל בֶּן־ גּוּנִ֔י רֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḥî ben- ‘aḇ·dî·’êl ben- gū·nî rōš lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Ahi son of Abdiel the son of Guni was head of their family . . .
verses.literalPt: Aí, filho de Abdiel, filho de Guni, príncipe da sua família.

verses.original: וַיֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בַּגִּלְעָ֥ד בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן וּבִבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וּבְכָֽל־ מִגְרְשֵׁ֥י שָׁר֖וֹן עַל־ תּוֹצְאוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū bag·gil·‘āḏ bab·bā·šān ū·ḇiḇ·nō·ṯe·hā ū·ḇə·ḵāl miḡ·rə·šê šā·rō·wn ‘al- tō·wṣ·’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and its towns and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Habitaram em Gileade em Basã, e nas suas aldeias, e em todos os arrabaldes de Sarom até os seus termos.

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ בִּימֵ֖י יוֹתָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: kul·lām hiṯ·yaḥ·śū bî·mê yō·w·ṯām me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·mê yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: All of them were recorded in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel
verses.literalPt: Todos estes foram registrados segundo as suas genealogias no dia de Jotão, rei de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, rei de Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵ֨ן וְגָדִ֜י וַחֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט־ מְנַשֶּׁה֮ מִן־ בְּנֵי־ חַיִל֒ אֲ֠נָשִׁים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י מָגֵ֤ן וְחֶ֙רֶב֙ וְדֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת וּלְמוּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵא֥וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên wə·ḡā·ḏî wa·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ- mə·naš·šeh min- bə·nê- ḥa·yil ’ă·nā·šîm nō·śə·’ê mā·ḡên wə·ḥe·reḇ wə·ḏō·rə·ḵê qe·šeṯ ū·lə·mū·ḏê mil·ḥā·māh ’ar·bā·‘îm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šiš·šîm yō·ṣə·’ê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: The Reubenites . . . the Gadites and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh . . . had 44,760 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . warriors . . . valiant men who carried the shield and sword drew the bow and were trained for battle
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Rúben, os gaditas e a meia tribo de Manassés, homens corajosos, que traziam escudo e espada, e que manejavam o arco, e que eram destros na guerra, foram quarenta e quatro mil e setecentos e sessenta, que saíam à peleja.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־ הַֽהַגְרִיאִ֑ים וִיט֥וּר וְנָפִ֖ישׁ וְנוֹדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū mil·ḥā·māh ‘im- ha·haḡ·rî·’îm wî·ṭūr wə·nā·p̄îš wə·nō·w·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: They waged war against the Hagrites as well as Jetur Naphish and Nodab
verses.literalPt: Fizeram guerra contra os hagarenos, Jetur, Nafis e Nodabe.

verses.original: וַיֵּעָזְר֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּנָּתְנ֤וּ בְיָדָם֙ הַֽהַגְרִיאִ֔ים וְכֹ֖ל שֶׁ֣עִמָּהֶ֑ם כִּ֠י לֵאלֹהִ֤ים זָעֲקוּ֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנַעְתּ֥וֹר לָהֶ֖ם כִּי־ בָ֥טְחוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·‘ā·zə·rū ‘ă·lê·hem way·yin·nā·ṯə·nū ḇə·yā·ḏām ha·haḡ·rî·’îm wə·ḵōl še·‘im·mā·hem kî lê·lō·hîm zā·‘ă·qū bam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·na‘·tō·wr lā·hem kî- ḇā·ṭə·ḥū ḇōw
verses.literal: And because they cried out to God in battle they were helped against their enemies and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands Because they put their trust in God He answered their prayers
verses.literalPt: Receberam auxílio contra eles, e os hagarenos e todos os que estavam com eles foram entregues às suas mãos. Pois, na peleja, clamavam a Deus, que lhes deu ouvidos, porque confiavam nele.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבּ֣וּ מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם גְּֽמַלֵּיהֶ֞ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ וְצֹ֗אן מָאתַ֤יִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וַחֲמוֹרִ֖ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ אָדָ֖ם מֵ֥אָה אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·bū miq·nê·hem gə·mal·lê·hem ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·ṣōn mā·ṯa·yim wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mō·w·rîm ’al·pā·yim wə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām mê·’āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites 50,000 . . . camels 250,000 . . . . . . sheep and 2,000 . . . donkeys They also took 100,000 . . . captives
verses.literalPt: Levaram o gado deles: cinquenta mil camelos, duzentos e cinquenta mil ovelhas e dois mil jumentos; e cem mil homens.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חֲלָלִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ נָפָ֔לוּ כִּ֥י מֵהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתֵּיהֶ֖ם עַד־ הַגֹּלָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥă·lā·lîm rab·bîm nā·p̄ā·lū kî mê·hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tê·hem ‘aḏ- hag·gō·lāh
verses.literal: and many others fell slain because the battle belonged to God And they occupied the land until the exile
verses.literalPt: Pois caíram muitos mortos, porque de Deus era a peleja. Ficaram habitando no lugar deles até o cativeiro.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֗י חֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יָשְׁב֖וּ בָּאָ֑רֶץ מִבָּשָׁ֞ן עַד־ בַּ֧עַל חֶרְמ֛וֹן וּשְׂנִ֥יר וְהַר־ חֶרְמ֖וֹן הֵ֥מָּה רָבֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh yā·šə·ḇū bā·’ā·reṣ mib·bā·šān ‘aḏ- ba·‘al ḥer·mō·wn ū·śə·nîr wə·har- ḥer·mō·wn hêm·māh rā·ḇū
verses.literal: Now the people of the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh were numerous They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is Senir also known as Mount Hermon
verses.literalPt: Os filhos da meia tribo de Manassés habitavam na terra e multiplicaram-se desde Basã até Baal-Hermom, Senir e o monte de Hermom.

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית־ אֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְעֵ֡פֶר וְיִשְׁעִ֡י וֶאֱלִיאֵ֡ל וְ֠עַזְרִיאֵל וְיִרְמְיָ֨ה וְהוֹדַוְיָ֜ה וְיַחְדִּיאֵ֗ל אֲנָשִׁים֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֣י שֵׁמ֔וֹת רָאשִׁ֖ים לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh rā·šê ḇêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·‘ê·p̄er wə·yiš·‘î we·’ĕ·lî·’êl wə·‘az·rî·’êl wə·yir·mə·yāh wə·hō·w·ḏaw·yāh wə·yaḥ·dî·’êl ’ă·nā·šîm gib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil ’an·šê šê·mō·wṯ rā·šîm lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: These were the heads of their families . . . Epher Ishi Eliel Azriel Jeremiah Hodaviah and Jahdiel They were mighty men of valor famous men and heads of their families . . .
verses.literalPt: Estes foram os cabeças das suas famílias: Éfer, Isi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremias, Hodavias e Jadiel, homens ilustres em valor, célebres e cabeças das suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיִּֽמְעֲל֔וּ בֵּאלֹהֵ֖י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּזְנ֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עַמֵּי־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ הִשְׁמִ֥יד אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·‘ă·lū bê·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem way·yiz·nū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê ‘am·mê- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- hiš·mîḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mip·pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land whom God had destroyed before them
verses.literalPt: Cometeram transgressões contra o Deus de seus pais e prostituíram-se, seguindo os deuses dos povos da terra, que Deus exterminou de diante deles.

verses.original: וַיָּעַר֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ ר֣וּחַ׀ פּ֣וּל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֗וּר וְאֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ תִּלְּגַ֤ת פִּלְנֶ֙סֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיַּגְלֵם֙ לָראוּבֵנִ֣י וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ֠יְבִיאֵם לַחְלַ֨ח וְחָב֤וֹר וְהָרָא֙ וּנְהַ֣ר גּוֹזָ֔ן עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·‘ar ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- rū·aḥ pūl me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr wə·’eṯ- rū·aḥ til·lə·ḡaṯ pil·ne·ser me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yaḡ·lêm lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·lag·gā·ḏî wə·la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh way·ḇî·’êm laḥ·laḥ wə·ḥā·ḇō·wr wə·hā·rā ū·nə·har gō·w·zān ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria that is . . . Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria to take the Reubenites the Gadites and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh into exile And he brought them to Halah Habor Hara and the river of Gozan where they remain to this day
verses.literalPt: O Deus de Israel excitou o espírito de Pul, rei da Assíria, e o espírito de Tiglate-Pileser, rei da Assíria, que levou cativos os rubenitas, os gaditas e a meia tribo de Manassés e os trouxe para Hala, Habor e Hara e para o rio Gozã, onde permanecem até o dia de hoje.
